meta_description:
497 likes, 1,455 comments - simrun.chopra on September 23, 2026: "Comment "breakfast" and ill send you a bunch of high protein recipes both Breakfast and dinner. The 2 people struggle with the most

As a working mom juggling a 100 things to me food and health needs to be practical. It needs to be something you and I can do on repeat without driving ourselves crazy or disrupting our home.

Now Imagine if youre living in a multi generational home ... how would this work ? Could vou do it for life ?

To me these things make the word "diet" feel like a huge issue. Like it needs  sacrifice and its so hard

Just today I told someone how we need to increase her calories. And she was like" im already eating ao much more than before I started"
 Note : she lost 4kgs last month

I think people dont realise that you can eat as much as you want as long as your burn more.

I think we need to change the way the word "diet" is perceived and focus on getting healthier and fitter

What do you say ?".
